rule.name: timeout-abandons-operation
rule.message: {0}(timeout, unit) stops waiting for the future, not for the task behind it: the TimeoutException handler neither cancels this future with cancel(true) nor rethrows, so the task keeps running with its thread and side effects, and a retry overlaps it. Call cancel(true) on this future in the handler or a finally block (cancel(false) lets a running task finish), or rethrow the TimeoutException to the owner.
